headline: Kenya's KCB Group Reports 24% Profit Rise to $451 Million
summary: KCB Group posted nine-month net earnings of $451 million, driven by mobile loan volume growth, foreign exchange income, and reduced non-performing loans.
why: KCB Group is one of Kenya's largest financial institutions, operating across East Africa.

impacts.name: KCB Group
impacts.why: Solid net earnings growth reflects improving credit quality and digital loan expansion.
